title: Bicep with App Service, Functions, and Storage
description: Deploy App Service, Azure Functions, and Storage accounts together in a single Bicep template.

data.text: A common pattern is deploying an App Service (or Functions app) together with the supporting resources it needs: an App Service plan, a storage account, and optionally a Key Vault for secrets.
Deploying a Complete Web App Stack
In this lesson, we will create a Bicep template that deploys a complete web application stack: a resource group, App Service plan, web app, storage account, and Key Vault.

data.title: Bicep - Complete Web App Stack
data.content: Deploy a resource group, App Service plan, web app, and storage account.

data.title: Bicep - Azure Functions with Consumption Plan
data.content: Deploy a Function app on the Consumption plan.

data.title: Deploy as a Unit
data.text: Keep related resources in the same template. A web app, its plan, and its storage account are usually deployed together and should not be split across templates.

terms.definition: A Bicep function that returns the access keys for a storage account. Use it to pass the storage key to the Function app.
A serverless hosting plan for Azure Functions where you pay only for execution time. SKU name is Y1.
A set of compute resources (VMs) that host one or more App Service apps. SKU determines the size and features.

data.title: Exercise: Deploy a Web App Stack
data.description: Deploy a complete web application infrastructure with Bicep.
steps: Create a Bicep template with targetScope = 'resourceGroup'
Add an App Service plan with S1 sku
Add a web app linked to the plan
Add a storage account for diagnostics
Deploy to a test resource group
Browse to the web app URL
data.expectedOutcome: A deployed web application stack with App Service plan, web app, and storage account.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Group related resources in the same Bicep template
Use listKeys() to get storage account keys for Function apps
targetScope = 'resourceGroup' is the most common scope for application infrastructure
Output the web app URL for easy access after deployment
data.takeaway: A single Bicep template can deploy an entire application stack. Keep it organized by grouping related resources.
